name: Castle of San Felipe de Lara
scope: Standing Castillo de San Felipe de Lara at Río Dulce following the 1955 reconstruction and later conservation, including the full castle shell, river bastion, terraced court, roofed lookouts, retaining edges and landward entry bridge.
era: Standing reconstructed exterior after the 1955 reconstruction, with extant architectural character supported by the exact 2008 exterior photograph and the mapped shell.

stories.title: Castle of San Felipe de Lara

originalReview.notes: Architecture in the 2008 water-side view anchors the silhouette, gray rubble walls, low stepped waterfront, rounded bastion, raised roofed lookout and entrance-side roofs. Geometry only.

review.method: Exact Qualla original and corroborating Commons first import log
review.notes: Started with cleared Qualla media. The native sole photograph and the original imported own-work release name the same photographer, sjc196. Qualla exact content matches the native fingerprint. Attribution-licensed alternatives, unconfirmed Flickr public-domain marks and archive-plan imagery were excluded.
